heading: Annual meeting
lead: The corporation may hold its annual meeting in a place the members of the corporation select.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2130436:20 (3d sentence words after 2d comma).Jan. 4, 1889, ch. 20, (3d sentence words after 2d comma), 25 Stat. 640. The words “members of the corporation” are substituted for “said incorporators” to reflect the probable intent.
